I have assessed the repository by comparing [`docs/api.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CTJ66A/workspace/docs/api.md) against the implementation in [`src/api.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CTJ66A/workspace/src/api.js) and [`src/limit.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CTJ66A/workspace/src/limit.js), and written the full assessment to [`ASSESSMENT.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CTJ66A/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md) without modifying any existing application code or documentation.

### What Was Verified
1. **API Endpoints & Versioning**: Documented as `/v1/events` (`GET`/`POST`), but implemented as `/v2/events`.
2. **Authentication**: Documented as requiring a Bearer token with `401` responses on failure; no auth logic is present in implementation.
3. **Pagination**: Documented as page-based (`?page=N`, 50 items/page); implemented as cursor-based (`?after=ID`, 25 items/page with `nextCursor`).
4. **Event Ingestion**: Documented as `201 Created` with created event body; implemented requiring an `idempotency-key` header (returns `400` if missing) and responding with `202 Accepted` (`{ accepted: true }`).
5. **Rate Limiting**: Documented as 100 requests/min per token; implemented as 600 requests/min per IP address (`req.ip`).
6. **Codebase & Test Suite Integrity**: Executed `npm test` to confirm test suite status, and verified [`ASSESSMENT.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CTJ66A/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md) was created cleanly.
